lessons.objective: See a house as a box with a triangle on top, then place the door, windows and chimney.
lessons.notes: Instructions were written for children in the proof of concept ("Great job, your house is done!"). Rewrite them in a calm adult voice and add a reference photo before approving.

generation.goal: Learn to draw a palm tree easily

mainForms: Gently curving slender trunk, slightly wider at the base
Cluster of rounded coconuts grouped together at the crown
Arching palm fronds radiating outward and drooping downward
importantDetails: Serrated, jagged frond silhouettes to clearly read as palm leaves
Gentle horizontal cross-bands along the trunk suggesting texture
A simple sandy base anchor line
detailsRemoved: Inner leaf vein lines on each frond leaflet to keep the pen work approachable
Heavy black shadows and fill colors to focus strictly on pure outline
Scattered sand pebbles and detailed ground hatching
analysis.drawingStrategy: Begin with the distinctive curved trunk to establish the posture and scale. Crown it with a tight cluster of coconuts, build the radiating canopy of palm fronds around them, and finish with the trunk rings and a grounded base.

lessons.objective: Build a palm front to back: overlapping coconuts, a curving trunk, then each frond as a spine and a zigzag of leaves
lessons.notes: Drawn by hand (Claude), without generation, from the same reference as palm-tree, 2026-09-11.

mainForms: Cluster of rounded coconuts gathered right at the crown
Tall, gently leaning trunk that curves leftward toward the ground
Fan of broad, jagged palm fronds radiating outward and arching down
importantDetails: Horizontal ring ridges spaced down the trunk
Serrated, sawtooth leaf silhouettes along the underside of each frond
Small sandy mound and tiny grass tufts anchoring the trunk base
detailsRemoved: Internal line hatching and fine grain on coconut shells to keep forms readable
Individual leaf ribs and parallel vein markings inside each frond
Multiple tiny sand specks and complex shadows beneath the tree
analysis.drawingStrategy: Start with the cluster of coconuts near the center, which establishes the focal anchor. Extend the trunk down to the ground, then build the crown outward from the upright center fronds to the heavy side-swept leaves.

generation.goal: Learn how to draw a palm tree easily

mainForms: A single curving trunk that leans slightly right and swells at the base
A crown of long fronds radiating from one point at the top of the trunk
A cluster of oval coconuts hanging at the top of the trunk
A low patch of sand at the base of the trunk
importantDetails: Ring bands running across the trunk
Feathery leaflet pairs along each frond spine, drawn as short strokes off the main line
Five or six separate coconuts, each with a small highlight line
Short tufts of grass where the trunk meets the sand
Pebble marks scattered on the sand
analysis.drawingStrategy: Start with the long curving trunk and its ring bands, then mark the crown point and build the fronds one at a time as a spine with paired leaflets. Finish with the coconut cluster and the sand at the base, so the tree stands on something.
